text:
maria: quick sync — we need to finalize the audit-event taxonomy and schema before the RBAC rollout next week. main concerns: naming conventions, enum fields (outcome/role), and what is customer-facing vs internal. can we align?

tyler: +1. my main ask is backwards compatibility for existing logs and a clear migration path for the stored events table. also kms-related events need consistent key identifiers (kms.key_id) and not full key material.

maria: good call. proposal: canonical event_type format: resource.action (e.g., model.deploy, user.session.create). add a top-level "outcome" enum: success|failure|denied|timeout. include actor.type = user|service|system.

li: frontend dependency here — we render a few event types in console activity feed. we need stable event_type strings for at least 2 weeks freeze after the spec lands. otherwise UI mapping breaks. :grimacing:

sam: product side: customer-facing events must omit internal IDs; use customer-visible resource_id and a hashed_user_id for PII. compliance wants traceability without leaking raw emails.

priya: exactly. compliance requires: (1) KMS ops log entries show key_id and operation (encrypt/decrypt/rotate) but redact key aliases and ARN if customer requests; (2) include a "sensitivity" tag on events: public|restricted|secret so we can filter exports. also we need a validation harness for customers to verify event coverage.

maria: follow-ups: create a short spec doc and a lightweight JSON Schema for validation. can someone draft the schema snippet?

tyler: dropping a starter snippet below — it's a proposed minimal contract for all events: inline for copy/paste

```
{
  "event_type": "resource.action",
  "timestamp": "2025-12-01T15:04:05Z",
  "actor": { "id": "<id>", "type": "user|service|system" },
  "outcome": "success|failure|denied|timeout",
  "resource": { "type": "model|key|dataset|org|user", "id": "<resource_id>" },
  "meta": { "client_ip": "x.x.x.x", "region": "us-west-2" },
  "sensitivity": "public|restricted|secret"
}
```

tyler: note: customer-facing schema should replace actor.id with actor.hid (hashed id) unless customer opts into PII logs. internal logs keep raw id.

priya: add: audit events for KMS must include kms.key_id and kms.operation. sample: kms.operation = encrypt|decrypt|generate|rotate. and kms.key_origin = AWS|HSM|CUSTOM.

li: small question — how do we signal rollback vs failed deploy? can outcome cover it or do we need event_type like model.deploy.rollback?

maria: prefer explicit event_type for semantic clarity: model.deploy, model.deploy.rollback. outcome still reports success/failure.

sam: on the validation harness — we should provide a test suite that runs against a customer's sample export and flags missing required fields and PII leakage. call it audit-validator. will work with infra to wire up a quick endpoint.

tyler: infra note: adding new required fields to the DB requires a backfill job. i can draft migration: add nullable columns, backfill from raw payload, then switch to non-null with deployment window. expect ~2 day runway.

priya: compliance timeline: we need the final spec by EOW so legal can review. if RBAC rollout slips, we want the audit schema gated.

maria: action items I hear: 1) tyler — draft full JSON Schema + migration plan (due T+2d). 2) sam — scope audit-validator tests + CI integration. 3) li — mark UI event_type freeze window and list top UI types. 4) priya — compliance redaction rules and sensitivity taxonomy. I'll collate into a single PR.

deploy-bot: CI: audit-spec/PR-412 passed basic checks — https://ci.internal/reports/412 :white_check_mark:

tyler: i'll put the schema draft at https://git.redwood/audit/specs/audit-schema-draft.md and open a draft PR. please comment inline on naming.

li: FYI UI list: model.deploy, model.rollback, user.session.create, user.session.revoke, key.rotate, key.create — i'll send a short list in the thread tomorrow.

sam: question — how do we version the schema? bump event_schema_version at top-level?

maria: yes add event_schema_version (semver-ish). include compatibility notes in the doc.

priya: one more: for customer audits we need an examples appendix with allowed/forbidden fields redaction examples. i'll draft.

maria: thanks all. i'll open the aggregation PR with the initial doc and action items. please add any immediate blockers here.

tyler: none from infra side, will start on migration and schema.

sam: no blockers, will coordinate audit-validator tests.

li: will prepare UI freeze list.

priya: on it.

maria: closing loop — i'll set a 30min sync if we need it, otherwise we'll coordinate in PR. :thumbsup:
